dialogues.speaker: Capac
dialogues.text: Hey there, are you helping me keep count?

dialogues.speaker: Yatlan
dialogues.text: Of course! I come from a business family. Wouldn't it be weirder if I didn't know how to do that?

dialogues.speaker: Yatlan
dialogues.text: C'mon, there's just one-third of the training assignment left to complete.

dialogues.speaker: Yatlan
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry about it. I'll remember it for you. You just concentrate on your exercise.

dialogues.speaker: Yatlan
dialogues.text: Hurry it up! Once you're finished, we can go chow down on some volcano cake!

dialogues.speaker: Capac
dialogues.text: You got it! Volcano cake always tastes best after training!

dialogues.speaker: Yatlan
dialogues.text: Wrong! Volcano cake is great to eat any day of the week!
